items.title: From tech glitches to bulk buying: How outages are spurring a wave of Costco sales
items.summary:
Following the shock of last week's various tech outages, Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on what panic-induced buying at outlets like Costco (COST) could mean for the next quarter of retail figures.

Today's panel includes Raymond James Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Matt Orton, Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian, The Wall Street Skinny Co-Founder Kristen Kelly, and Clocktower Group Chief Market Strategist Eric Wallerstein.
